questions.text: Which one of the following is NOT equivalent to [latex]p\leftrightarrow q[/latex]?
questions.solution:
[latex]p\leftrightarrow q[/latex] is true when p and q are equal.

- Options 1, 2: [latex](p\rightarrow q)\wedge(q\rightarrow p)[/latex] [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] equivalent
- Option 4: both false or both true [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] equivalent
- Option 3: exactly one is true, which is XOR, the negation of [latex]p\leftrightarrow q[/latex]

Answer: [latex](\neg p\wedge q)\vee(p\wedge\neg q)[/latex]

questions.text: A cube of side 1 unit is placed in such a way that the origin coincides with one of its top vertices and the three axes along three of its edges. What are the co-ordinates of the vertex which is diagonally opposite to the vertex whose co-ordinates are (1, 0, 1)?
questions.solution:
The origin is a top vertex and the cube lies below it. From (1, 0, 1), x and z run 0 to 1 and y runs 0 to [latex]-[/latex]1.

The diagonally opposite vertex flips every coordinate to the other end: x 1 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 0, y 0 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [latex]-[/latex]1, z 1 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 0.

Answer: (0, [latex]-[/latex]1, 0)

questions.text: The conic section that is obtained when a right circular cone is cut through a plane that is parallel to the side of the cone is called _____
questions.solution:
A plane parallel to the slant side of a cone gives a parabola. (Steeper planes give a hyperbola, flatter ones an ellipse, and a horizontal one a circle.)

Answer: parabola

questions.text: Let A be a finite set having [latex]x[/latex] elements and let B be a finite set having [latex]y[/latex] elements. What is the number of distinct functions mapping B into A.
questions.solution:
Each of the y elements of B can map to any of the x elements of A.

Number of functions = [latex]x^y[/latex]

Answer: [latex]x^y[/latex]
